articles.title: 輝達晶片伺服器銷往內地案 台灣檢方收押3人
key_points: Taiwanese authorities have arrested 3 individuals for allegedly selling NVIDIA high-end servers to China, Hong Kong, and Macau without proper permits.
The servers were produced by Supermicro and contained NVIDIA high-end chips, which are subject to strict regulations in the US.
The suspects were arrested after a 2-week investigation and are currently being held in custody.
The case highlights the complexities of international trade and the need for strict regulations to prevent the unauthorized sale of sensitive technology.

key_developments: Junshi Biotech will receive an upfront payment of 215 million yuan from Fosun Wanbang for the licensing of the anti‑IL‑17A antibody JS005 in Greater China.
The agreement allows Fosun Wanbang to develop, register, manufacture and commercialise JS005, potentially generating up to 1.125 billion yuan in milestone payments for Junshi Biotech.
Junshi Biotech is entitled to a tiered sales royalty of a double‑digit percentage of net sales in the Greater China market.
The licensing covers all development, registration, production and commercialisation rights for JS005 within the Greater China region.

articles.title: 君實生物與復星萬邦簽訂授權許可協議
key_points: 君實生物與復星醫藥的全資子公司復星萬邦簽訂《授權許可協議》。
該公司授權復星萬邦關於偌考奇拜單抗(「JS005」或「抗IL-17A單抗」)在大中華地區的開發、註冊、生產及商業化的權利。
君實生物將獲得2.15億元的首付款，並有資格獲得最高達11.25億元的開發和銷售里程碑付款，以及大中華地區淨銷售額雙位數百分比的分級銷售提成。
articles.attention_reason: Licensing agreement between biotech firms may affect stock performance
